{"fragment": true, "screens": [{"tag": "screen", "attrs": {"name": "screenpart_TimeshiftOverviewList", "size": "1920,1080"}, "children": [{"tag": "convert", "attrs": {"type": "COCTemplatedMultiContentEx"}, "children": null, "text": "{

		MultiContentEntryText(pos=(x3,0), size=(col3_w,ih), flags=RT_VALIGN_CENTER|RT_HALIGN_RIGHT, text=3),
